change.summary: Amends Annex I of Directive 2011/83/EU to update financial services contract rules for distance selling. The amendment applies to distance and off-premises contracts within the scope of the directive.

obligations.text: Amend Annex I of Directive 2011/83/EU in accordance with Annex I to this Directive.
obligations.quote: Annex I is amended in accordance with Annex I to this Directive.

reasons: The regulation updates financial services contract rules for distance selling, but you sell furniture and leather goods, not financial services.
The obligation is directed at amending the directive's annex, not at sellers of physical products.
